scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "python -m uvicorn backend.app.main:app --reload --reload-dir backend --port 8000" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.format: python -m ruff format backend && npm run format --prefix frontend
